name: Atomstack A40 Pro
tagline: Mid-tier Atomstack with better frame and 40W-class cutting claims
tldr: Step up from A5 Pro with a stiffer frame and stronger cutting marketing (40W combined). Real-world performance beats A5 but still sits below Sculpfun/xTool for consistency. Common pick for makers who started on A5 and want more power without jumping brands.
mainObjective: Upgraded Atomstack for stronger cuts and more reliable engraving than A5

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: May outgrow quickly if business grows
beginnerNotes: If buying fresh at $500+, compare Sculpfun S30 Ultra or Ortur LM3 before defaulting to Atomstack loyalty.
proTips: Verify optical power with a meter if cutting depth matters for your products. Stiffen frame corners if you add extension kits.
primaryUse: Mid-budget open-frame diode bridging Atomstack entry models and premium Sculpfun/xTool tier.
